items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: The Salar yield improvement project in Chile has achieved a 50-60% operating rate. Albemarle is well-placed to capture a growing share of long-term lithium demand as global EV adoption accelerates. ALB stock carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.headline: Can Albemarle's Lithium Expansion Fuel Sales Volume Growth?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation ALB is strategically executing its projects aimed at boosting its global lithium conversion capacity. ALB saw higher sales volumes (up 11% year over year) in its Energy Storage unit in the second quarter.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock amid softer EV demand in China, elevated inventory levels and expectations of increased supply from mine restarts and capacity expansions.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.
